evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Entering a name and optional description are attributes of a single 'create game' feature, not independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: This describes one feature (inviting estimators via a URL) without combining separate implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round by entering an item (including the input field detail) is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing all session items is one feature; the explanatory purpose is not a separate implementable feature.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item (including re-estimation) is a single selection feature, not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding an item is one implementable feature; the justification is not an additional feature.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item is a single independent feature.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Providing the ability to reveal estimates early is one feature, not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average is a single decision/acceptance feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling the estimate on unanimous cards is one conditional automation feature.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering the agreed estimate is a single actionable feature.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating a previously estimated story is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is a single feature; the reason given is not a separate implementation.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste import is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is a single feature (finding a game is the goal, not a separate feature).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting as HTML is a single export feature (format is an attribute).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting as CSV is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is one feature (data removal).

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Entering multiple fields are attributes of a single 'create account' feature, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Logging in is a single feature (credentials listed are attributes of the same feature).

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Displaying dates/times in local timezone is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Choosing between estimation scales is a single configurable feature; the enumerated options are attributes of that choice.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Limiting invites to 15 is a single constraint/feature.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining by entering a name is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the current item is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Seeing the full list of items is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Notifying who has given an estimate is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simultaneous reveal after all have estimated is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Allowing estimate changes until draw completion is a single temporal constraint feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates for the current story is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Showing which participant gave which estimate is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Starting a shared two-minute timer is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior is an attribute of the timer feature, not an independent feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Scrolling through prior rounds is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Maintaining card order across draws is a single consistent-UI feature.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Allowing changes until draw completion is one feature (similar to PP-034 but not multiple features within this story).

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail near cards is a single UI personalization feature.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compliance with XHTML and CSS standards is a single standards-compliance objective (the two standards are attributes of the same requirement).

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing a glossary is a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Creating database indexes is one implementable developer task/feature.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser functionality is a single compatibility feature; listing multiple browsers are attributes of the same requirement rather than independent features.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a single feature/quality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness is a single non-functional feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is one feature (character encoding support).

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Providing sensible URLs is a single usability/URL design feature.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Implementing friendly error pages is one feature.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymizing/storing results non-identifiably is a single data-handling/privacy feature.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing usage metrics is a single analytics feature.
